title: Inner-perimeter trust anchors (trust-anchors-inner.json)
description: Separate from the edge anchors. Inner perimeter only (~/memory/anchors or /etc/memory/anchors): never installed on the edge or bridge, because it contains administrator networks, objectGUID values and setting pins. Separate format, signature namespace (ssh-keygen -Y sign -n memory-anchors-inner) and serial: a document of one kind cannot pass as the other. Signed by the same 2 of 3 signers. Read by the gateway, admin panel and workers (shared/src/anchors.ts); they read the edge anchors (anchors.schema.json) separately.

admin.description: Administrators: networks, objectGUID values and WebAuthn keys.

networks.description: Networks allowed to open the admin panel (admin.networks). Nonempty: with anchors active, an empty list would deny sign-in to everyone, so a draft with an empty list is not issued.

settings_pins.description: Pinning of keys of class anchored. The name is <category>.<key>. {value} is only for a non-secret key without audit: fingerprint in the policy; a secret (secret in 04-seed.sql) and a key with audit: fingerprint (customer lists under NDA, open-check rules) take only {hmac}: HMAC-SHA256 with the key HKDF(appSecret, "memory-anchors-pin") over "<category>.<key>\n" and the canonical JSON of the value. The HMAC key exists only inside; a bare sha256 is not accepted: a password can be recovered from it by brute force. The loader refuses when the kind of pinning is wrong.

security_mode_min.description: Security mode floor: the effective mode is the stricter of the security.mode setting and the floor of the latest applied inner anchors, the same in the gateway, the workers and the SQL security_mode(). With advanced, returning to basic is not possible without a new 2-of-3 document (with a basic floor) or a “retirement document” (floor_advanced). No field — no floor (earlier documents pass as before).

retire.description: “Retirement document”: a 2-of-3 signed end of the internal anchors with the target basic. An applied retirement document is a legacy state: no anchors-disabled marker and no daily alert; its pins and networks do not apply, and there is no mode floor. Its number is the same serial as the internal anchors: replay and rollback do not pass. It also replaces the second person’s signature in a return-to-basic request submitted before it was applied, when there is no second administrator with keys (once per serial). With the retire field, an advanced floor is not set.

cidr.description: Network: IPv4 prefix at least /8, IPv6 at least /32; /0 and other “whole internet” ranges are rejected (X-Forwarded-For trust, administrator networks).
